author: sega_jenesis_
title: Hiring digital artists for custom Pokémon binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰

author: Or Cole
title: Looking for character artist for upcoming romance book
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please! I am a romance author.

author: creativeleadscommunity
title: Hiring 3D Character Artist & Animator for indie game
content: A small independent game development team is looking for a 3D Character Artist & Animator (Remote - US Preferred/Applicants Worldwide Considered). A freelance contract for an artist to create 3D characters and creatures for a co-op game. Responsibilities include modeling, UV unwrapping, texturing, rigging and creating expressive gameplay animations in Blender. Compensation is $15 USD/hour for up to 8 hours per week, starting with a 30-day paid contract. Interested? Join at creativeleadscommunity.com
